title: Bœuf Bourguignon
description: A classic French dish originating from the Burgundy region, Bœuf Bourguignon is a hearty stew made with tender beef, mushrooms, and bacon.
instructions: Season the beef with salt and pepper.
In a large Dutch oven, cook the bacon over medium heat until browned.
Remove the bacon from the pot, leaving the drippings behind.
Add the beef to the pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the onion, carrot, and celery to the pot and cook until the vegetables are softened.
Add the peanut butter to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the red wine, beef broth, and tomato paste to the pot, stirring to combine.
Return the bacon to the pot.
Add the mushrooms to the pot and stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Braise the stew for 2-1/2 to 3 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh parsley.
